title: Code and stored results: choosing the exponent of a fractional power basis in adaptive robust regression
description:
Python and R scripts, stored Monte Carlo replications and a Lean 4 project behind the article Choosing the exponent of a fractional power basis in adaptive robust regression (S. Zabolotnii) and its online supplement.

The estimator is a one-step regression estimator on a four-column fractional power basis of a robust generating element, whose exponent is chosen on a finite grid by the estimated asymptotic variance. paper/make_tables.py and paper/make_supplement.py regenerate every table of the article and the supplement from the stored results without new simulation. The Lean project machine-checks the deterministic steps of the selection theorem.
